faq_heading: Homes near Regent Road Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Regent Road Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Regent Road Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Regent Road Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Regent Road Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Ecole Salish Secondary (0.6 km south-west), Clayton Heights Secondary (0.9 km south) and Hazelgrove Elementary (1.1 km south-east).

How the Regent Road Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Regent Road Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit some distance away. blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Regent Road Elementary

14 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Regent Road Elementary in a straight line (9 elementary, 3 secondary, 2 other; 2 independent). The closest is Ecole Salish Secondary, 0.6 km away, and the farthest on this list is Langley Meadows Elementary, 3.0 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Hazelgrove Elementary (1.1 km); the nearest independent school is Crescent Heights Academy (2.6 km). Other elementary schools close by: Hazelgrove Elementary (1.1 km south-east), Maddaugh Elementary (1.5 km east), Adams Road Elementary (1.6 km south-west), Katzie Elementary (1.7 km south-east), Hillcrest Elementary (1.8 km south). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Hazelgrove Elementary, 1.1 km south-east of Regent Road Elementary.
